 Kendall Jenner Is Helping Jacob Elordi House-Hunt in LA, but They Have No Plans to Move In, Source Says
 Jacob Elordi
 Kendall Jenner
 Kylie
 Page Six
 Timothée Chalamet
 Chateau Marmont
 Hollywood
 Jacob Elordi earned his first Oscar nomination this year for his role as the Creature in Guillermo del Toro's Frankenstein (Credit: Harald Krichel / CC BY-SA 4.0, cropped) 
 Kendall Jenner is helping Jacob Elordi look for a house to buy in Los Angeles, but the pair don't plan to live together, a source told Page Six. 'Jacob is looking for his own place,' the insider said. The source added that the pair aren't rushing into anything serious.
 The claim emerged this month, as the model and the Frankenstein actor made their debut together at a Hollywood gala. Neither Jenner, 30, nor Elordi, 29, has spoken publicly about the romance. For now, unnamed insiders, not the couple, are the only source of details about their plans.
